newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU cereals experts will fix final oilseed payment.
newsitem.headline: EU cereals experts will fix final oilseed payment.

text.p: European Union cereals experts will discuss the final oilseeds aid premium for 1996/97 on Thursday, a trade source said on Wednesday.
"The experts group will decide whether the Blair House maximum limit of 5.482 million hectares less 10 percent compulsory set-aside has been exceeded," the source said.

The European Commission has already confirmed that the overall EU limit has not been exceeded and the EU cereals management committee is expected to vote on the experts' recommendation later on Thursday.
The committee meeting will be routine, dealing with the usual tenders and export restitutions for rice and cereals, the source added. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
